# `aitbc operations agent list`

List registered agents, optionally filtered by status.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc operations agent list [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--status` | text | — | no | Filter by status |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc operations agent list
```
